ablation: FreshCache-L2Verify (optional gate after L2 hit + normal L3)
support_score: V(q,C) = max_c cosine(E(q), E(c)); BGE-M3 dense (CLS, L2-normalised); c = each served page at the version L3 actually served, text via the audits' own 2000-char loader
labels_for_selection: judge-agreed SUFFICIENT/INSUFFICIENT on the ACTUAL served L2/L3 evidence, Llama-3.1-8B + Qwen2.5-7B, both must agree; disagreements excluded
label_population: L2 hits on the VALIDATION cluster split only; every request appearing in the existing 300-case audit is EXCLUDED so nothing is fitted on audited examples
objective: maximise Youden's J = TPR - FPR, where POSITIVE = INSUFFICIENT; TPR = share of INSUFFICIENT L2 hits rejected, FPR = share of SUFFICIENT L2 hits rejected
test_use: the frozen gamma is replayed once on the held-out test split; no tuning on test; sensitivity at gamma+-0.05 reported separately
